structural_variants.otherCytogenetics: Chromosome 5 probes:  81% of cells were missing a signal for the 5q probes but had two signals for 5p; another 19% of cells were missing a signal for the 5q probes but had 3-4 signals for 5p. | BCR (22q11.2): 81% of cells had 3-4 signals, consistent with gain of 22. | NUP98 (11p15.4), MLL (11q23): ~90% of cells had three signals, consistent with trisomy 11. | CEP8: 35% of cells had 3-4 signals, consistent with gain of chromosome 8.
